pipelineSteps.title: Data Collection & Verification
pipelineSteps.description: Gathering real, open-access environmental datasets from FSI, IMD, NCCR, INCOIS, and Ramsar RSIS with explicit source citations.

pipelineSteps.title: Data Cleaning & Normalization
pipelineSteps.description: Standardizing multi-year climate series, handling spatial proxy variance, and converting units for machine learning readiness.

pipelineSteps.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
pipelineSteps.description: Correlation matrix analysis between annual rainfall, sea-surface temperature anomalies, mangrove coverage loss, and erosion rates.

pipelineSteps.title: Feature Engineering & Matrix Selection
pipelineSteps.description: Constructing feature vectors comprising climate normals, shoreline erosion percentages, mangrove density indices, and cyclone hazard frequency.

pipelineSteps.title: Model Candidate Training & Evaluation
pipelineSteps.description: Training and cross-validating Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers against validated vulnerability benchmarks.

pipelineSteps.title: Model Integration & Risk Classification
pipelineSteps.description: Deploying the evaluated model to output evidence-backed Coastal Risk Levels (Low, Moderate, High).

candidateAlgorithms.name: Random Forest Classifier
candidateAlgorithms.purpose: Ensemble decision modeling across non-linear environmental features

candidateAlgorithms.name: XGBoost Classifier
candidateAlgorithms.purpose: Gradient-boosted decision trees optimized for small-to-medium ecological datasets
